test_dump_load_roundtrip: test the dump and load functions by encoding a list with nested dict and verifying round-trip equality
dump_hyperparams_to_base64: create a base64 encoded compressed string from a Python object like a list or dict of hyper-parameters
load_base64_to_object: create a Python object by decoding a base64 compressed string that was produced by the dump function
export_xp_sigs: export experiment signatures to a shareable base64 encoded string using the export_action function
import_xp_from_stdin: import experiment configurations from a base64 encoded string on stdin using the import_action function
